sentence: This project supports research that profiles single cells and tissue sections to learn how costimulatory signals control T cells and myeloid cells.
This project supports clinical research on the causes, prevention, and treatment of digestive diseases.
This project builds a malaria vaccine made of five small peptides that aims to block infection and spread by mosquitoes.
This project tries to find out how fructose raises cholesterol levels.
This project studies how a specific cell population affects lifespan and healthspan, using an animal model and single cell transcriptomics.
This project builds a liver tissue and microfluidic organ-on-a-chip system that predicts drug-induced liver injury without using animals.
This project provides equipment and testing methods to help a laboratory analyze animal food samples and respond to outbreaks.
This project studies whether overdose prevention policies lower fatal overdoses and how local context changes their effect.
This project uses human and mouse sarcoma models with genomic and proteomic tools to find the molecular drivers of a lethal sarcoma.
This project builds the leadership and structure for a center that develops point-of-care diagnostic tools for HIV, AIDS and emerging infectious diseases.
This project tests a slippery coating that aims to keep peripheral vascular grafts from failing.
This project tests which ankle foot orthosis stiffness and angle make walking and stair ambulation easier for children with cerebral palsy.
This project studies how genetic variants in one gene cause inflammation and different disease features in an inborn error of immunity.
This project studies the molecular steps that turn cells into hematopoietic stem cells when triggered by inflammatory mediators.
This project studies how a bacterial toxin called alpha-hemolysin damages and kills kidney epithelial cells.
This project builds a method using functional MRI and deep learning to speed up tuning of deep brain stimulation electrodes for Parkinson's disease.
This project studies how the orbitofrontal cortex and its link to the auditory cortex shape perceptual learning of sounds.
This project builds statistical methods to map how microbes interact with each other, with host genomics, and with disease.
This project studies how opioid signaling weakens the immune response against tumors and how that pathway could be used in treatment.
This project studies how a Kelch13 gene mutation that resists artemisinin has spread across Africa and how it could weaken malaria treatments.
